name: review-description
description: Hydrology-reader review of one algorithm description and its fixtures before the function is opened to the implementer

steps.prompt: Moment: description. Function {{function}}. Description {{description}}. Read the description, the fixtures it names, and its manifest cases; run the template validator. Write .kiro/workflow-output/{{function}}/findings-description.md in the findings format and end your final message with the VERDICT line. Finish with send_message severity success when the file is written.
